race.comment: STARVECCHIO (10) looked handy saluting at Rockhampton on debut before being tipped out for further time to furnish. Was well in the betting when resuming at the Sunny Coast but just missed the frame on that occasion. Will be much better for that hit-out and where there's smoke there's fire. Goes on top. UPSTART LOVER (1) boasts a win over this track and trip and gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim. Looms as the main danger. MONDELLO (8) brings SA formlines to the equation and any market confidence must be noted. TAYLOR'S RAGE (6) will be rock-hard fit for this and is another to get some weight off. In the mix. STREET DAZZLER (3) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
